SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.dish_id, d.name AS dish_name, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.rating, r.content, r.images AS images_json, r.sec_state AS sec_state, r.is_hidden AS is_hidden, r.created_at, r.useful_count AS useful_count FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN dish d ON r.dish_id = d.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC ORDER BY r.useful_count DESC, r.created_at DESC
SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM review r JOIN dish d ON r.dish_id = d.id WHERE d.stall_id = #{stallId} AND r.is_hidden = 0 AND r.sec_state = 'pass'
